entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: Substate where UE camps on a suitable/acceptable cell but initiates no EMM signalling and ignores paging requests.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI
entities.description: Substate entered when USIM is removed from UE.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Substate entered when UE loses coverage.

entities.name: EMM-NULL
entities.description: State entered when UE is deactivated (e.g., powered off).

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH
entities.description: Substate entered when UE receives request to establish eCall over IMS or non-emergency call.

entities.name: USIM removed
entities.description: Event where USIM is physically removed from UE.

entities.name: Coverage lost
entities.description: Event where UE loses radio coverage.

entities.name: UE deactivated
entities.description: Event where UE is powered off or deactivated by user.

entities.name: eCall over IMS request
entities.description: Request from upper layers to establish eCall over IMS.

entities.name: Non-emergency call request
entities.description: Request from upper layers to establish call to HPLMN designated non-emergency MSISDN/URI.

entities.name: No EMM signalling
entities.description: UE behavior in eCALL-INACTIVE state: initiates no EMM signalling and ignores paging requests.

relations.description: USIM removal causes transition to NO-IMSI substate.
Coverage loss causes transition to PLMN-SEARCH substate.
UE deactivation causes transition to EMM-NULL state.
eCall over IMS request causes transition to ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate.
Non-emergency call request causes transition to ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate.
eCALL-INACTIVE state requires UE to initiate no EMM signalling and ignore paging.
